title: Second local comparison component
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an open, T a closed subset contained in U, and V = X minus T. Use derived restriction L and direct image R [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Given adjunctions L ⊣ R and S ⊣ L [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact], let F be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] with cohomology supported on T. If phi : S(F) → R(F) has right adjunct inverse to the unit of S ⊣ L at F, then phi restricts to an isomorphism on both U and V.

source.place: Tag 08DF (Lemma 20.33.6), restriction computations using Tags 08FE and 08BS

proof.text: Exact extension by zero induces a left adjoint to derived restriction with invertible unit. Uniqueness of left adjoints transports this to S. Full faithfulness of open direct image makes its counit invertible. The adjunct equation therefore makes L(phi) invertible. On V, Tag 08FE and the support hypothesis make R(F) zero; the restriction formula for extension by zero and uniqueness of left adjoints make S(F) zero. Thus phi on V is invertible between zero objects.

proof_origin.reason: Separate the independent unit and left/right comparison obligations in Tag 08DF; second reading supplied complete component arguments.

theorem supported_open_pushforward_local_comparisons_second (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTU : T ⊆ (U : Set X))
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : (V : Set X) = Tᶜ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))] :
    (∀ (adj : ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι)
        (S : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory X)
        (adjS : S ⊣ ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory)
        (F : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme), IsPerfect U.toScheme F →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : U.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) n).obj F).val.presheaf
            x))) →
      ∀ φ : S.obj F ⟶ (schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj F,
        adjS.unit.app F ≫ (adj.homEquiv (S.obj F) F).symm φ = 𝟙 F →
        ∀ W : X.Opens, W = U ∨ W = V →
          IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W).mapDerivedCategory.map φ))
